name: GeoVision Geowebserver <= 5.3.3 -  Local File Inclusion / Cross-Site Scripting
author: shamo0
description: GEOVISION GEOWEBSERVER <= 5.3.3 is vulnerable to several XSS, HTML Injection, and Local File Include (LFI) vectors. The application fails to properly sanitize user requests, allowing injection of HTML code and XSS, as well as client-side exploitation, including session theft.
